CREATIVE ARTS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #9
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: CREATIVE ARTS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Primary colours are: (1 mark)
   A. Green, orange, and purple
   B. Red, blue, and yellow
   C. Black, white, and grey
   D. Brown, pink, and gold

2. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. The ticket price
   B. The speed of the music
   C. Only the costume
   D. Only the volume

3. Warming up before sport helps to: (1 mark)
   A. Guarantee a trophy
   B. Replace drinking water
   C. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk
   D. Remove the need for rules

4. Best practice when working on Descant Recorder: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Descant Recorder.
   B. Damage equipment used for Descant Recorder.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Descant Recorder.
   D. Practise Descant Recorder with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

5. Best practice when working on Painting and Montage: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Painting and Montage.
   B. Damage equipment used for Painting and Montage.
   C. Practise Painting and Montage with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Painting and Montage.

6. Best practice when working on Athletics: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Athletics.
   B. Practise Athletics with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Athletics.
   D. Damage equipment used for Athletics.

7. Best practice when working on Melody: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Melody.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Melody.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Melody.
   D. Practise Melody with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

8. Best practice when working on Rhythm: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Rhythm.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Rhythm.
   C. Practise Rhythm with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Damage equipment used for Rhythm.

9. Best practice when working on Percussion Musical Instruments: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Percussion Musical Instruments with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Percussion Musical Instruments.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Percussion Musical Instruments.
   D. Damage equipment used for Percussion Musical Instruments.

10. Best practice when working on Photography: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Photography.
   B. Damage equipment used for Photography.
   C. Practise Photography with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Photography.

11. Best practice when working on Gymnastics: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Gymnastics with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Damage equipment used for Gymnastics.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Gymnastics.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Gymnastics.

12. Best practice when working on Netball: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Netball.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Netball.
   C. Damage equipment used for Netball.
   D. Practise Netball with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Indigenous Kenyan Games and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Analysis of Creative Arts Works 15 Total Number of Lessons 180 NOTE: The number  and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Analysis of Creative Arts works and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Percussion Musical Instruments and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
